verdict.rationale: Sierra's docs say agents are grounded in managed knowledge such as Help Center content, FAQs, and policies (sierra-docs-7). Guardrails can be set via prompts in Ghostwriter (sierra-docs-8), and answers are traceable to their knowledge sources (sierra-docs-13). Agent Checks and Simulations catch problems before release (sierra-docs-4, sierra-docs-18). None of this explicitly shows that the agent refuses to invent policies, prices, or promises, or declines safely when a question falls outside its knowledge. Missing for 10: documented anti-hallucination or grounding enforcement, explicit safe-decline behavior for off-knowledge questions, controls specific to prices and commitments, independent or hands-on corroboration.
